calls.title: Growthbook <> Customer.io - Sync
calls.summary: Growthbook sales rep Daniel Wathne discussed with Pino Nguyen (customer) the ongoing trial of Growthbook’s experimentation platform. Key pain points included a Visual Editor error blocking test setup and a need for a legal agreement for the trial due to data integration with Snowflake. Next steps: Dan will send a $0 order form with standard terms of service for legal review, escalate the technical issue internally, and follow up midweek; a decision between cloud vs. self-hosted will be made after colleague Bill returns.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Customer.io - POC Check In
calls.summary: The call between GrowthBook (Daniel Wathne, Sales; Logan Bates, Solutions Engineering) and Customer.io (Elliot Shaw, Demand Gen; Andreas Pappas, PM) focused on A/B testing Customer.io’s trial signup page using GrowthBook’s visual editor, feature flags, and new MCP server/AI analyst tools. Key pain points included Andreas’s engineering bandwidth constraints and the internal feature flag system’s lack of statistical rigor. Next steps: Andreas will attempt to run a test using the green screen concept, GrowthBook will share MCP setup guides in Slack, and a follow-up check-in is scheduled for end of week.

calls.title: Growthbook <> Customer.io - Snowflake Data Sync
calls.summary: In this call, GrowthBook sales rep Daniel Wathne and solutions engineer Logan Bates met with Customer.io’s data analyst Kristina Im and data engineer Jack Meussdorffer to resolve a Snowflake data sync issue. The problem was that experiment exposure events were not flowing back to Snowflake, causing errors in metrics; they discussed using GrowthBook’s event forwarder to automatically send exposure data. Next steps: Logan and Dan will confirm if the Snowflake event forwarder is ready and follow up with the Customer.io team that afternoon.
